product.shortDescription: Governed industrial reliability software that turns condition readings, work history, operating context, and engineering evidence into traceable, human-approved decisions.
product.longDescription: SyncAI gives industrial asset teams one governed workspace for condition monitoring, FRACAS and failure analysis, asset onboarding, downtime-recovery coordination, deterministic reliability methods, and auditable decision cases. Teams can begin with customer-provided exports and use scoped integration patterns through APIs, database views, file exchange, event streams, or a customer-side gateway. Analyses keep data-quality, applicability, conflicts, uncertainty, and missing evidence visible. Named people retain engineering and operating authority: SyncAI does not autonomously change limits, maintenance intervals, work orders, schedules, asset state, or return equipment to service. Production integrations and outcome claims require customer-specific validation. No savings, uptime, failure-avoidance, accuracy, certification, or ROI result is guaranteed.
highlights: Trace recommendations to supplied evidence, explicit gaps, accountable owners, and human approval gates.
Coordinate failure investigation, maintenance decisions, execution readiness, recovery, and value verification in one platform.
Start read-only from exports or scoped integration patterns; validate every production connector in the customer environment.

categories.rule: Select only categories that directly describe the software; do not use categories as pain-copy variants.

commercial.pricingModelDecision: Required before the initial limited product because the AWS pricing model cannot be changed after that point.
commercial.decisionRule: Choose subscription, contract, or contract-with-usage only after entitlement, metering, refund, test-price, and plan semantics are approved and implemented.

customerAccess.reason: AWS posts x-amzn-marketplace-token to the registration URL, while the current production SPA does not provide a conforming server-side POST registration handler.
customerAccess.supportUrlAction: Publish and verify a customer-facing support route.
customerAccess.eulaAction: Approve an EULA and host the PDF at the AWS-required public location.
customerAccess.logoAction: Approve a compliant product logo and host it at the AWS-required public location.
customerAccess.architectureNote: Do not claim the AWS deployed-on-AWS designation; the current production application and control planes are not evidenced as running entirely on AWS.

acquisitionExperiments.headline: Reduce recurring unplanned downtime with evidence-governed failure investigation
acquisitionExperiments.promise: Use the SyncAI Failure Investigation Agent to turn failure history, work orders, observations, and available evidence into a reviewable investigation with hypotheses, gaps, actions, owners, approval gates, and outcome verification.
acquisitionExperiments.successMetric: Unplanned downtime hours, repeat-event rate, and verified avoided downtime
acquisitionExperiments.claimsBoundary: SyncAI does not guarantee downtime elimination or claim a root cause that the supplied evidence cannot establish.

acquisitionExperiments.headline: Coordinate a controlled return to stable service
acquisitionExperiments.promise: Bring work, labour, materials, constraints, permits, custody, approvals, execution evidence, and return-to-service gates into one governed recovery event.
acquisitionExperiments.successMetric: Time to return to service, blocker delay, first-time-right, recovered hours, and separately verified value
acquisitionExperiments.claimsBoundary: SyncAI cannot self-release work, clear isolations, accept return to service, or invent missing duration and readiness evidence.

acquisitionExperiments.headline: Find avoidable or mistimed maintenance work without automating the decision
acquisitionExperiments.promise: Review PM tasks, intervals, failure history, execution records, and operating context to identify evidence-bounded cost-reduction candidates and a verification plan.
acquisitionExperiments.successMetric: Maintenance labour and material cost, emergency-work ratio, task yield, and failure recurrence
acquisitionExperiments.claimsBoundary: No interval is adopted automatically; accountable engineering authority retains the decision.

releaseGates: Approved AWS Marketplace seller account with tax, bank, and identity requirements complete
Owner-approved immutable pricing model, dimensions, public prices, refund policy, and EULA
Server-side POST registration handler and buyer email/account path
Active production schema, ResolveCustomer, entitlement or metering integration, and lifecycle delivery
Subscription status and support controls visible in the product
Limited-listing end-to-end preview purchase with entitlement and cancellation witnesses
AWS review approval followed by separate owner authorization for public visibility
